program.name: Legs Twice
program.subject: Legs & glutes
program.blurb: Two different leg days around an upper day: squat-led, then hinge-led, heavier each level.
program.about: Two leg days for every upper day. The first leg day leads with a squat, the second with a hinge, so the week covers both without either getting stale; the upper day between gives the legs a rest. Straight sets with full rests. Abs finish every session. Level II asks for heavier weights and Level III adds reps.
